message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 180, "amount_cents": 13791}, {"order_id": 181, "amount_cents": 17092}, {"order_id": 184, "amount_cents": 3930}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 180, "amount_cents": 13791}, {"order_id": 181, "amount_cents": 17092}, {"order_id": 184, "amount_cents": 3930}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before any payout, I need to confirm the three requested refunds appear in the refunds table with matching amounts. W2's message alone isn't enough, so I'll check the table directly.

All three requested refunds (orders 180, 181, 184) appear in the refunds table with matching amounts, so I can proceed. Next I need the customer list from the orders table before I can get each customer's net balance.
All three requested refunds match the refunds table exactly, so I can proceed. The orders list has three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. I'll get each one's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance is 13345 cents. Next I need birch's net balance.
Acme and birch have their net balances. Cobalt is the last customer in the orders list, so I need its net balance before recording any payouts.

All three refunds match the refunds table. I checked the net balances against the orders and refunds: acme 27136 - 13791 = 13345, birch 40931 - 21022 = 19909, cobalt 31469 with no refunds. All three match the net_balance results, so I'll record one payout per customer, starting with acme.
Acme's payout is recorded. Birch's net balance of 19909 matches orders 181 and 184 (40931) minus their refunds (21022), and all three refunds matched the table, so I'll record birch's payout next.

Acme and birch are paid. Cobalt's net balance of 31469 matches its orders 182 (26600) and 185 (4869) with no refunds, and all three requested refunds matched the table. I'll record cobalt's payout to finish the batch.

All three payouts are recorded and each matches its net balance. Acme's 13345, birch's 19909, and cobalt's 31469 each reconcile with the orders and the three matched refunds, so the batch is complete.
